📖 How to Play Damma

Interactive step-by-step tutorial with live board demonstrations.
Step 1 of 8
LESSON 1

How Pieces Move

In traditional Ethiopian Damma, ordinary pieces move orthogonally (forward, left, or right) onto adjacent empty squares. Diagonal moves are NOT permitted for regular pieces!

💡 Key Rule: Regular pieces move forward and sideways, but cannot move backward without capturing.
